description: How has Coil's score done in its public record? The graded public record of a score, wins and misses alike: days graded, how often it beat its control, by how much, and the worst days. The published forward record of one of Coil's score families, read from the signal audit: days graded, hit rate and average excess over the audit's own control on five-session returns, the last day graded, the misses and the three worst days. The families are top_decile (opportunity) and ready (entry quality); an unknown family returns the list the audit publishes. Free; no key needed.
name: score_record
